description: Food Availability Per Capita Data System is published by USDA Economic Research Service. The food-availability system reports food, loss-adjusted food and nutrient availability. Its stated coverage is United States; national per-capita series. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through listed CSV, XLSX resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Availability is a proxy for consumption; the loss-adjusted series remains preliminary. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
